verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents a 'pre-integrated catalog' of SAML SSO apps: the custom-SAML instructions apply only to apps not in that catalog. It also offers SSO to company cloud apps with managed Google credentials and automatic user provisioning to third-party apps such as Office 365. The Marketplace 'business apps' listing is an add-on store, not an SSO catalog, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: evidence of catalog size (thousands of apps), OIDC pre-built integrations, evidence that setup takes minutes, independent or hands-on corroboration of catalog coverage.
